en.title: The World's 3rd Smallest Lizard. Can You Name It?
en.description: The minute leaf chameleon from Nosy Be, Madagascar, reaches only 3.4 cm, has independently rotating eyes and shows spotted patterns when stressed. It is the third-smallest lizard ever described.
